This merger is designed to foster operational synergies and improve resource allocation. It is expected to streamline the management structure and optimize operational costs, thereby building a more competitive gold loan venture. The plan is subject to approvals from the Reserve Bank of India and various authorities.

banking-economy.title: Subhash Chandra's dissenting lenders Canara Bank, Union Bank move NCLAT against NCLT order
banking-economy.summary: Dissenting lenders have challenged the NCLT order approving Subhash Chandra's personal insolvency plan. The Essel Group chairman's plan proposes a Rs 6.5 crore payment against creditor claims. Lenders argued that five entities linked to Chandra's family improperly influenced the voting process. The NCLT approved the plan after a third member ruled in its favor. The appellate tribunal will now hear the lenders' challenge on Tuesday.
